title: Margaret's Longing
description: While Jean is ill from overwork, you've been tasked with handling some citizens' commissions on her behalf. Where has Margaret's pet cat Prince run off to this time?

mainQuestExcel.title: Margaret's Longing

dialogs.text: ...So, yours is the cat that went missing.
Venti! Have you come to help?
Me, here to help you? Why, on the contrary, it is I who needs helping!
But Paimon just saw you talking to Margaret about Prince...
Aha! So, Prince is the name of the feline fiend who thieved my spare <color=#00E1FFFF>astral iron strings</color>!
Though it gladdens my heart to see that the free-spirited ethos of Mondstadt is alive and well in creatures great and small... Still, it's a bit audacious!
Spoken just like a parent who chooses to spoil said rascal!
Haha, Prince is a mischievous little rascal alright!
Indeed. Just like Barbatos...
Ahaha, yes, quite... quite... Ahem! Now, let's see about getting ourselves an audience with his little highness, Prince Rascal of Mondstadt!
I have a performance tonight, and without my spare strings, I shall have to disappoint my audience.
What would a kitty cat want with lyre strings anyway?
Everyone knows cats go crazy for a ball of string!
What!?
These lyre strings are made of astral iron, which contains Anemo energy. That makes them extremely durable, so I normally just roll them up in a ball to make them easier to carry.
That's a trick of the trade from a traveling bard!
The strings contain Anemo energy?
#That'll help us! {NICKNAME}, it's time for you to use your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color> again!
Paimon's sure there must be some elemental footprints or something.
Thank you all. Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. It's a black cat you're looking for.
Oh— Take this <color=#00E1FFFF>fish</color>, it's little Prince's favorite food. Maybe it will help you find him.

flow.stepDescription: Find Margaret and ask about her commission

dialogs.text: Where have you been looking?
Prince should be somewhere around the Marketplace. Remember, he's got black fur.
Meow!
Wow, Prince has very keen senses. It didn't take much to scare him off.
See if you can approach him crouching <color=#00E1FFFF>from behind</color>. That way, your footsteps will be quieter.
It must be difficult not being able to float, hee-hee.
If you're anxious to find Prince, why not coax him to you with some <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>? Kitty cats do love eating fish.
If you've run out of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fish</color>, go grab some more from the lake. Now, back to it!

flow.stepDescription: Talk to Margaret to finish your commission.

dialogs.text: Drat! He's run off again.
But where is he going? Hmm, Paimon wonders if...
Prince! Good boy, that's my Prince, I knew you'd come home to me...
*panting* Gah! After all that searching...
Oh Princey, how could you leave me like that...
Looks like those two need some time to themselves...
Look at you... Did Prince take you on a bit of a wild goose chase, then?
Heh... Cheer up, even if you didn't catch him, he's back here thanks to you.
And he still has the astral iron strings with him!
I daresay that a private performance played using these very same strings would not be an excessive way to show my gratitude! ...Ah, ah...
Ah what?
ACHOO!
*cough* Haha... Apologies. At this distance, my cat allergy seems to be rearing its head...
Oh, now Paimon gets why you didn't go looking for your strings by yourself...
Hehe, anyway, thanks for the help, I'll be going now— a—achoo!
Prince! Where did you go running off to? Thank goodness you're safe...
He made sure we had our work cut out for us looking for him.
Oh Princey, how could you leave me like that...
Looks like those two need some time to themselves...
And here are your astral iron strings, Venti.
You found them! Wonderful! I was not optimistic they would turn up.
